_doc: PLAN.md 4.6, 4.8a (owner, 2026-10-26). Outside Creative, placing a tile pays its materials and placing a gun or thruster pays its price_gc (weapons.json, thrusters.json). Removing a tile gives its materials back 1:1; removing a part puts it in the inventory, and reinstalling it is free, except that a gun reinstalled on another mount type than it last had pays refit. Sell pays sell_rate of a part's price, rounded down (v2: higher with faction reputation). Balance pass 2026-10-26 (owner: about 10x too cheap; you need to work for your upgrades): tile costs and part prices x10, a smaller starting wallet, and kills pay.

market._doc: 4.8c. GC per unit: buy is what the market charges, sell what it pays. A Large hull tile (120 hull) is 240 GC to buy; an armor tile 760; a hardpoint 1040.

drops._doc: 4.8c. What a kill pays, until pickups (Phase 5.4): share of the materials the enemy's tiles cost, plus gc_per_tile GC a tile, both x (1 + per_level x (encounter level - 1)), rounded down. A 20-tile practice barge at level 3 pays about 300 GC's worth.

dev_profile._doc: A new dev profile (until profiles, Phase 6.2): its ship is a data/blueprints id, and its guns become items. The wallet is about 4400 GC's worth: a couple of armor tiles, or most of a cannon.
